endurance.name: Endurance

sourceObject.name: Endurance
sourceObject.description: You can push your body beyond normal limits.
sourceObject.effect: You can go twice as long without food, water, or sleep, and you have advantage on Constitution saves against exhaustion.

endurance.originalQuestion: Resolve twice-as-long food/water/sleep deprivation against actual schedules, quantities and cumulative penalties, not infinite sustenance. Identify exact CON saves against Exhausted and environmental Strain, and whether sleep tolerance changes any rest benefits. No unprinted healing, RP recovery or universal immunity.

sourceDirection.name: Endurance
sourceDirection.originalQuestion: Resolve twice-as-long food/water/sleep deprivation against actual schedules, quantities and cumulative penalties, not infinite sustenance. Identify exact CON saves against Exhausted and environmental Strain, and whether sleep tolerance changes any rest benefits. No unprinted healing, RP recovery or universal immunity.

originalSourceObject.name: Endurance
originalSourceObject.description: You can push your body beyond normal limits.
originalSourceObject.effect: You can go twice as long without food, water, or sleep, and you have advantage on Constitution saves against exhaustion.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: NEW precise deprivation bridge: while this feat is operative, accrue only half the ordinary food-, water- and sleep-deprivation time toward each respective unmet-need deadline. Use the same elapsed world clock, preserving fractional accrued time and prior exposure; do not halve the actual daily food/water quantity. A nominal 24-hour no-water threshold therefore requires 48 actual hours of otherwise identical deprivation under the feat. Partial intake and resets follow the actual deprivation procedure. Acquisition does not erase already accrued debt or penalties, and suppression changes future accrual rather than replaying old time. Gain advantage on actual Constitution saves whose source prevents or resists gaining the Exhaustion condition. NEW: include a Constitution save against ordinary environmental expedition Strain only if the source explicitly equates that save with exhaustion; do not apply it to Dissonance, serum Strain or every similarly named track. Sleep tolerance gives no short/long-rest benefits, extra active-work Watch, free recovery or exemption from an actual hard work cap. The live expedition verdict must supply the final baseline schedules and distinct track mapping.
sourceDirection.submittedNewChoices: Half-rate future deprivation accrual, no retroactive cure, exact save predicate and preserved rest/work limits.
submittedWorkedCases: Twelve actual hours without water adds six hours to a deprivation clock that would ordinarily accrue one-for-one. It does not produce half a ration of missing water.
Remaining awake longer does not itself restore RP or grant a beneficial long rest. An unrelated Warrior serum-Strain save does not gain this feat's advantage by name alone.
sourceDirection.decision: NEW FS-12 adopts a checkpoint-based exception to canonical daily shortage/Rest Debt penalties; it replaces the hypothetical deprivation timer, not the EX58 clock or requirements.
sourceDirection.completeAuthoringProcedure:
Keep advantage on an actual Constitution save to resist Exhaustion; this supplies no save where the governing rule assesses a penalty directly. NEW Endurance/EX58 bridge: keep the same 24-hour provisioning checkpoints, eight-hour Watches, two-active-work ceiling, actual Rest Debt opening, deadline at the end of the second following Watch, and safe eight-hour rest cure. Do not double a Watch, create food/water, lengthen an actual sleep-debt deadline, or treat work as rest.
Maintain two separate feat records, foodWaterPending and sleepPending, each initially 0 and limited to 0 or 1. At a canonical daily checkpoint where food/water shortage is the sole reason for the one expedition-Strain penalty, 0 becomes 1 and that one penalty is omitted; 1 becomes 0 and the original one penalty applies. A day actually meeting both food and water requirements clears foodWaterPending. Another unmet mandatory logistical requirement still causes its original single daily penalty; Endurance does not reduce it or add a second daily penalty. The day remains unsupported wherever its actual requirements are unmet, even when the feat omits a Strain point.
At an actual canonical sleep-debt penalty event, apply the same 0→1/omit, 1→0/apply sequence to sleepPending. Assess each original event once: the unpaid deadline event and a subsequent missed designated Rest Watch follow their own EX58 scheduling; do not create an hourly or per-Watch penalty. Debt remains owed and deadlines reset only as EX58 says. A genuinely completed safe eight-hour rest clears sleepPending and actual Rest Debt, even if it supplies no additional beneficial-long-rest resource recovery. Food/water and sleep credits never offset each other. Other Strain, Exhaustion, air, weather and hazard causes retain their original rules.
Acquisition clears neither existing Strain nor existing debt. If the feat is unavailable at a checkpoint, apply the original cause-specific penalty and clear that cause's pending credit; availability later cannot rewrite the past. Preserve all assessed and omitted events and their causes. This is an explicitly NEW interpretation of 'go twice as long': it halves the frequency of the applicable canonical penalty events, not the elapsed length of every irregular sleep-debt window. Literal older wording and the rejected generic-timer draft remain historical.
sourceDirection.newRuleProvenance: All submitted NEW/proposed completions retained by this decision and all departures below are authoring decisions of FEAT327-SOURCE-2026-10-11, not recovered source wording. The original object remains immutable.
workedCases: A standard actor lacks water but has all other daily provisions. At the first 24-hour shortage checkpoint Endurance omits the one Strain point and sets foodWaterPending=1; at the next equally unsupported checkpoint it applies one and returns the counter to0. Both days are still unsupported; no water or recovery permission appears.

A missed Rest Watch opens actual Rest Debt. At its unchanged deadline Endurance may omit its first sleep penalty, but the debt is not cleared. A later canonical missed-Rest penalty applies the second point and resets only the normal EX58 deadline. A real safe eight-hour rest clears the debt and sleepPending, not a previously spent RP pool or another beneficial-long-rest allowance.

forager.name: Forager

sourceObject.name: Forager
sourceObject.description: You can find food and water in the wild.
sourceObject.effect: You can find enough food and water for yourself and up to 6 other people each day in any terrain except deserts or arctic regions.

forager.originalQuestion: Preserve self plus up to six others per day and desert/arctic exceptions. Define time, checks, actual availability, creature-size portions, edible food versus potable water, conservation/transport and group overlap. Do not conjure food in a stripped/sealed area or automatically grant abstract Supply unrelated to actual resources.

sourceDirection.name: Forager
sourceDirection.originalQuestion: Preserve self plus up to six others per day and desert/arctic exceptions. Define time, checks, actual availability, creature-size portions, edible food versus potable water, conservation/transport and group overlap. Do not conjure food in a stripped/sealed area or automatically grant abstract Supply unrelated to actual resources.

originalSourceObject.name: Forager
originalSourceObject.description: You can find food and water in the wild.
originalSourceObject.effect: You can find enough food and water for yourself and up to 6 other people each day in any terrain except deserts or arctic regions.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: NEW finite interpretation of the source guarantee: in an accessible non-desert, non-arctic area that actually contains enough recoverable edible food and potable water, spend one active eight-hour forage Watch to gather the normal daily food and water requirement for yourself and up to six other ordinary Small/Medium people. This feat guarantees that result from qualifying available resources without a separate yield roll; it does not guarantee access through a hazard, remove contamination or defeat a resource-specific harvesting gate. Identify a real foraging area and deplete its recorded stocks. The actual expedition procedure supplies food/water units, body-size requirements, carry weight and Supply conversion; this feat creates no extra abstract Supply. Larger or unusual consumers use their actual greater requirement from the same finite quantity, not seven unlimited creature-day portions. Record one feat forage output per holder per24 elapsed hours, shared across all locations, with the window beginning on completion; a second feat owner can work separately only against remaining real stock and their actual time. Deserts and arctic regions use ordinary foraging. A stripped, sealed or foodless place cannot satisfy the prerequisite, and no water appears because food exists. Preserve, transport and consume the actual output normally.
sourceDirection.submittedNewChoices: Eight-hour guaranteed-yield procedure, qualified stock/access boundary, 24-hour output cadence and standard-person quantity. Literal seven-person promise preserved where its actual resources exist; other cases explicitly require conference.
submittedWorkedCases: An adequately stocked temperate area can provide seven standard person-days of both food and water after the holder's real Watch. The carried water still needs sufficient containers and capacity.
A previously depleted chamber cannot yield another seven person-days. Food present without a potable water source cannot silently fulfill the missing water half.
sourceDirection.decision: Keep the source guarantee only against real finite stock and author exact EX58 food/water ceilings, not abstract Supply or free transport.

selectedFullSharedRule.title: Endurance: explicit EX58 checkpoint adaptation
selectedFullSharedRule.wording:
NEW explicit replacement for GD-09's hypothetical half-speed no-water timer: the source phrase 'twice as long' is implemented against EX58's actual deprivation PENALTY EVENTS, not by inventing a second elapsed calendar or changing when daily needs/Rest Debt are recorded. Keep canonical24-hour food/water settlement, scheduled Rest, debt-opening time, second-following-Watch deadline, later missed-Rest deadline resets, real safe8-hour repayment and work limits unchanged.
Maintain two owner-specific bounded credits: foodWaterPending in{0,1}, and sleepPending in{0,1}, initially0 when first legally acquired with no prior debt forgiven. At a canonical daily settlement deficient in food or water, first determine the source's single1-Strain shortfall, not one per need. If Endurance is operative and this penalty has no independent non-food/water cause, toggle foodWaterPending:0→1 prevents that one Strain;1→0 permits the original1 Strain. A genuinely fully food-and-water-supported day clears the pending credit. Missing mandatory non-food/water support still imposes the original daily1 Strain regardless of this feat, never adds a second daily Strain, and does not falsely count as a supported day. Actual partial consumption and unsupported-day recovery restrictions remain.
For each distinct canonical sleep-deprivation1-Strain event (an unpaid due deadline or another missed scheduled Rest while indebted), apply the same0→1 prevent /1→0 original1 rule to sleepPending, with no new event created and no cancellation of the debt/deadline update. Genuine safe8-hour debt-clearing Rest clears sleepPending, even if it grants no additional beneficial rest rewards. Reaching a due boundary still marks that event evaluated once. If Endurance is absent/suppressed at a checkpoint, apply the original penalty and clear that cause's pending credit; prior prevented/inflicted Strain is never replayed. The two causes cannot pay each other's counter. Previous Strain, established debt and spent rest rewards remain.
This is an expressly NEW narrowing of the generic timing promise to half-frequency canonical penalty events: it does NOT assert that irregular emergency-based sleep deadlines themselves become exactly twice as many elapsed hours. It preserves EX58 rather than silently substituting the draft's nonexistent24-hour no-water timer. Gain advantage on actual CON saves to prevent/resist the Exhaustion condition; environmental Strain qualifies only if its actual source expressly makes that CON save an exhaustion save. Automatic shortage/debt gains create no save. Dissonance, Warrior serum Strain and differently scoped injury saves do not acquire this advantage. Other explicit deprivation-damage/air/hazard clocks are unchanged; the feat does not grant breathing, nutrition, thermal immunity or extra work/rest credit.

currentPublic.name: Forager

sourceObject.name: Forager
sourceObject.description: You can find food and water in the wild.
sourceObject.effect: You can find enough food and water for yourself and up to 6 other people each day in any terrain except deserts or arctic regions.

currentPublic.operationalRules:
NEW finite interpretation of the source guarantee: in an accessible non-desert, non-arctic area that actually contains enough recoverable edible food and potable water, spend one active eight-hour forage Watch to gather the normal daily food and water requirement for yourself and up to six other ordinary Small/Medium people. This feat guarantees that result from qualifying available resources without a separate yield roll; it does not guarantee access through a hazard, remove contamination or defeat a resource-specific harvesting gate. Identify a real foraging area and deplete its recorded stocks. The actual expedition procedure supplies food/water units, body-size requirements, carry weight and Supply conversion; this feat creates no extra abstract Supply. Larger or unusual consumers use their actual greater requirement from the same finite quantity, not seven unlimited creature-day portions. Record one feat forage output per holder per24 elapsed hours, shared across all locations, with the window beginning on completion; a second feat owner can work separately only against remaining real stock and their actual time. Deserts and arctic regions use ordinary foraging. A stripped, sealed or foodless place cannot satisfy the prerequisite, and no water appears because food exists. Preserve, transport and consume the actual output normally.
NEW explicit quantity ceiling: the seven ordinary Small/Medium daily food-and-water portions are at most14lb edible food and56pints potable water in one completed480-active-minute Watch. Each pint of water is1lb for the existing cargo accounting. A Large consumer normally uses4lb/16pints from this same stock. These are food/water only, not seven complete Supply Units: no oil, sundries, storage or transport is awarded. If the full guarantee cannot be supported, before work declare an ordinary lawful forage attempt or a smaller supported quantity under this feat; its no-yield-roll benefit may recover only that predeclared real accessible amount. The one-completion/24-elapsed-hour and all actual acquisition/handling restrictions still apply.
workedCases: One lawful Watch recovers14lb food and56pints water for seven standard people from actual stock. Water adds56lb; the output is70lb before containers, and includes no oil or sundries.

A source has only4lb food and8pints safe accessible water. A predeclared smaller feat attempt cannot recover more than those amounts; a second worker or new container cannot recreate the depleted stock.

EX58ExactParagraphs.text: ### FL-03 — One clock, work and rest

The campaign uses one elapsed clock. A Watch is eight hours; a day contains Morning, Afternoon and Evening Watches. Combat rounds, rests, travel, treatment and work occupy their actual time within that clock. Completing a task does not add a second Watch. Entering Haven, changing teams or starting initiative does not reset elapsed time.

A generic Watch task needs **480 active minutes** before its completion check. Feasible unfinished work can continue in another Watch, without a proportional completion reward. Exact recipes, uninterrupted training, treatment, rest and spells keep their own interruption rules. Guarding, travelling, casting, directing, interpreting, assisting or working cannot also count as incompatible rest. Passive carriage qualifies for rest only when a genuinely suitable safe berth and the actual rest requirements are satisfied.

Plan at most two active work Watches and one Rest Watch per person each day. Evening is the default Rest slot; change it prospectively before that day's first assignment. Voluntary extra noncrafting travel or guard duty can replace Rest and incur its real costs and Rest Debt. This supplies no third crafting, training, research or harvesting Watch. Emergencies still consume time and interrupt the activity underway.

Missing a scheduled Rest creates **Rest Debt**. If an emergency interrupts Rest, the debt opens after that emergency ends; otherwise it opens when the missed Rest Watch ends. Complete a qualifying safe eight-hour Rest by the end of the second following canonical Watch. If the debt remains unpaid at that deadline, gain 1 Strain once for that due event and keep owing the Rest. Missing another scheduled Rest while indebted gives 1 Strain and resets the deadline. There is no automatic additional Strain every second or every Watch merely because the same debt remains.

A safe eight-hour Rest clears the debt even when you cannot receive another Long Rest's benefits. Keep the separate limits: one beneficial Long Rest per 24 elapsed hours, two beneficial Short Rests between beneficial Long Rests, the existing four-hour Morale Rest, and 24-hour Haven care. Trance reduces sleep, not the eight-hour Long-Rest requirement. Use the actual Strain and recovery chapter for what can be removed.

**Supply is a basket of real goods:** 2 lb of ration-equivalent edible food, 8 pints of potable water, 1 pint of compatible lamp oil in its flask, and 0.25 lb of ordinary camp sundries. The food and water cover one Small or Medium character's daily demand; Large characters require twice those quantities. This is game accounting. Two pounds of food equal three reviewed Cooking servings; a Large food day is six servings.

Track food and water actually consumed, by recipient and lot. Ordinary partial rations credit their edible mass. A fractional magical meal never gives a fractional benefit unless its own source permits that. The same serving cannot be spent in a recipe and remain available to eat.

Oil and sundries are spent when actually used. Do not burn spare oil or throw away sound stock to satisfy an abstract daily debit. The source lamp burns one pint in six hours. One actual light may serve several people within its real illumination, with its fuel spent once. A sufficient daylight or other safe lighting plan can use no oil; extra darkness, heating or work needs its real equipment and fuel.

At each canonical 24-hour day endpoint, settle each recipient's actual food, water and necessary declared logistics support. A recipient short of any requirement gains **1 expedition Strain total for that day's shortfall**. Missing food and water does not give two Strain. Retain partial consumption credit. The unsupported day blocks Strain removal; that block can clear on a later day only with a real sufficient provisioning plan available and maintained. Crossing a gate does not erase needs: actual Haven/home support pays needs outside the expedition.

Allocate shortages before the deadline. Joining, leaving or changing size/form divides demand by actual time and diet; it never refunds goods already consumed. A diet exception removes only its stated obligation. It gives no transferable provisions, fuel or camp labor. Unsupported nonmount Tiny, Huge or Gargantuan diets require their real profiles; mounts use their separate profiles.

If an exact procedure charges **one whole Supply**, reserve and commit the entire physical basket, or a substitute that procedure actually permits. Wound treatment keeps its one-Supply cost at the start, even if treatment fails or is interrupted. Food or water genuinely consumed by its named patient or healer can credit that person's daily need once. The committed basket does not also remain in inventory or feed another person.

**Provisions.** The printed 5 cp daily feed reference buys one actual species-compatible animal-day quantity from the catalogue: Camel 12 lb, Donkey/mule 10, Elephant 60, Draft horse 16, Riding horse 12, War horse 16, Mastiff 2, Pony 8, Warhound 3. This is an explicit provisional price/quantity choice. Actual compatible stock is required. Water is separate: respectively 32, 24, 128, 40, 32, 40, 8, 16 and 12 pints/day, with real containers and weight. These replace the human Supply basket for those animals; add no human oil ration or free desert-fasting trait. Unmet daily food/water causes at most one ordinary expedition Strain for that day, not a duplicate for each missing component.
